title: Deep learning-driven de novo discovery of binders targeting the transmembrane domain of BamA.
authors: Du, Minghui; Xin, Yuqiao; Xu, Benao; Zhang, Yang; Han, Linjie; Ji, Bingjie; Zhao, Jian; Zhao, Yongshan
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用深度学习框架DeepTM-Bind和分子动力学模拟，从头设计靶向BamA跨膜结构域的蛋白结合物，属于蛋白质结构计算与AI驱动的设计研究，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is an escalating global health threat, with multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria presenting a particularly serious clinical challenge. The unique outer membrane (OM) structure serves as a natural barrier against conventional therapeutics, so that treatment strategies become more complicated. Notably, drug development aimed at the transmembrane (TM) domains of membrane proteins remains highly limited. To overcome this bottleneck, we established an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven framework for the design and screening of BamA transmembrane (TM) domain-targeting binders. This framework employs a multi-channel convolutional neural network (DeepTM-Bind), which integrates heterogeneous protein features to achieve high predictive accuracy. Building upon this foundation, we further developed a multidimensional evaluation system to guide de novo design strategies. Using this integrated approach, binders targeting the lateral gate of BamA were successfully generated. All-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations within a membrane environment, combined with multiscale mechanistic analyses, confirmed the structural stability and strong binding potential of the candidate molecules, and revealed a previously unrecognized binding mode. Collectively, this study introduces an advanced computational paradigm for therapeutic design targeting TM domains and provides a promising strategy to combat multidrug-resistant Gram-negative pathogens.
abstract_zh: 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）是一个日益严峻的全球健康威胁，其中多重耐药革兰氏阴性菌构成了尤为严重的临床挑战。其独特的外膜（OM）结构作为常规治疗药物的天然屏障，使得治疗策略变得更加复杂。值得注意的是，针对膜蛋白跨膜（TM）结构域的药物开发仍然极为有限。为突破这一瓶颈，我们建立了一个人工智能（AI）驱动的框架，用于设计和筛选靶向BamA跨膜（TM）结构域的结合分子。该框架采用多通道卷积神经网络（DeepTM-Bind），整合异质性蛋白质特征以实现高预测精度。在此基础上，我们进一步开发了一个多维评估系统，以指导从头设计策略。利用这一集成方法，成功生成了靶向BamA侧向门控的结合分子。在膜环境中进行的全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟，结合多尺度机制分析，确认了候选分子的结构稳定性和强结合潜力，并揭示了一种此前未被识别的结合模式。总体而言，本研究引入了一种针对TM结构域治疗设计的高级计算范式，并为对抗多重耐药革兰氏阴性病原体提供了一种有前景的策略。
